title: Priority change priority-change.kp.symbol-manipulation-three-caller-gate
summary: Quotient, distribution, and cancellation passed human checkpoints and release verification. The cross-caller verdict promotes seven compiler requirements, keeps operation-specific motifs local, and advances the repository to a separately reviewed canonical semantic-motion compiler tranche.

sourceRefs.intent: Human accepted quotient, distribution, and cancellation as the contrasting evidence required before symbol-motion promotion; this supersedes the planned linearity-only pressure gate in the active run.
